description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter trigger, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Greedy Freebooter by paying {B}.
Repeat.
